RULING on the three objectives that neither graded instrument assesses: accept with the record, no change required for delivery. (1) jdbc-data-access-project#o2 is assessed in substance. The practical at 4cbf022b lists swapping-the-in-memory-repository-for-a-jdbc-one#o1-#o3, prepared-statements-and-sql-injection#o2 and transactions-and-acid#o2, and its instructions require a JDBC repository behind a supplied interface with PreparedStatement parameters and one all-or-nothing transaction. Those are the same skills as project#o2. Only the project brief's objective id goes unassessed, and project#o1-#o3 stay with the JDBC lab under option A. (2) group-by-and-having#o3 (fix an ungrouped column) and seeding-sample-data#o2 (INSERT ... SELECT with generate_series) are not assessed by either instrument, but both topics are: group-by o1/o2 in the MCQ and o2 in the practical; seeding o1/o3 in the practical and the MCQ. The captain's rule is all-topic coverage, which holds at 22/22 topics. Adding an MCQ item would reopen the private bank, its validation and critic loops for two low-transfer gaps, against the faster-review direction. A practical change belongs to the labs owner. Carry-forward, not blocking: at the next bank or practical revision, give group-by-and-having#o3 to the MCQ (it fits an Analyze debug item, still within 45 questions at 2 minutes each) and seeding-sample-data#o2 to the practical's seeding task.
